questions.question: 1. Change the code so that questions default to 4 possible answers, but teachers have the option to add or remove answers (example: 2 answers for True/False or 6 answers for choices A-F) 2. Include the option for teachers to create matching question with default of 4 keys and 4 elements. Allow option to add or remove pairs (example: 6 elements to match to 6 keys). Allow option to include more elements than needed as distractors. 3. Allow teachers to have option for multiple correct answers (example: select all that apply) 4. Partial credit is to be awarded for questions with multiple response or matching options. 5. When in student mode, if a question or answer does not have an image associated with it, there should be no notice shown on the screen that no image is attached.
